'''Payra Port Authority''' is an autonomous port authority in charge of the third port in [[Port of Payra]], [[Bangladesh]], and is located in [[Patuakhali]], [[Bangladesh]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Payra Port Development Will Enhance India-Bangladesh Ties – Analysis|url=http://www.eurasiareview.com/20012017-payra-port-development-will-enhance-india-bangladesh-ties-analysis/|website=Eurasia Review|accessdate=2 April 2017|date=20 January 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=PM discloses mega plan for Payra Port|url=http://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/2016/10/05/pm-discloses-mega-plan-payra-port/|website=Dhaka Tribune|accessdate=2 April 2017|date=5 October 2016}}</ref> The chairman of the Payra port authority is Rear Admiral [[Golam Sadeq]].  

==History==
The Port authority and the port was established on 19 November 2013 through the Payra Sea Port Act 2013.<ref>{{cite web|title=Welcome to Payra Port Authority|url=http://www.ppa.gov.bd/site/page/baa1e3c7-9aaa-41ce-92be-b8fa8eb38582/%E0%A6%B8%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%AC%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%97%E0%A6%A4-%E0%A6%AC%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%B0%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%A4%E0%A6%BE|website=ppa.gov.bd|publisher=Payra Port Authority|accessdate=2 April 2017|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Trial run of Payra port starts today|url=http://www.thedailystar.net/business/trial-run-payra-port-starts-today-1262599|website=The Daily Star|accessdate=2 April 2017|language=en|date=1 August 2016}}</ref> The port started commercial operations from August 2016 under the port authority.<ref>{{cite web|title=Payra Sea Port to open commercially Saturday|url=http://businessnews24bd.com/payra-seaport-to-open-commercially-tomorrow/|website=businessnews24bd.com|accessdate=2 April 2017}}</ref> In 2016 [[China Harbour Engineering Company]] and [[China State Construction Engineering]] had signed an agreement with the authority to improve the port.<ref>{{cite web|title=China's CHEC and CSCEC to develop Payra deep-sea port in Bangladesh|url=http://www.ship-technology.com/news/newschinas-chec-cscec-to-develop-payra-deep-sea-port-in-bangladesh-5694105|website=Ship Technology|accessdate=2 April 2017}}</ref> The deals were worth more than US$500 million and were signed in the Ministry of Shipping in Dhaka.<ref>{{cite web|title=China companies sign $510m deals for Payra seaport|url=http://www.thedailystar.net/business/china-companies-sign-510m-deals-payra-seaport-1327276|website=The Daily Star|accessdate=2 April 2017|language=en|date=9 December 2016}}</ref> The same year the port authority signed an agreement with [[Bangladesh Navy]] to build the approach road to the port.<ref>{{cite web|title=Navy to build Payra Port road|url=http://www.thedailystar.net/business/navy-build-payra-port-road-1301203|website=The Daily Star|accessdate=2 April 2017|language=en|date=20 October 2016}}</ref>

In December 2017 [[Jan De Nul]] started proceeding on a 550 Million Euro dredging contract.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.jandenul.com/en/pressroom/press-releases/jan-de-nul-group-has-entered-in-a-joint-venture-company-agreement-with-the|title=Jan De Nul Group has entered in a Joint Venture Company agreement with the Payra Port Authority to proceed with EUR 550 million port dredging contract {{!}} Jan De Nul Group|website=www.jandenul.com|language=en|access-date=23 December 2017|archive-date=24 December 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171224102729/http://www.jandenul.com/en/pressroom/press-releases/jan-de-nul-group-has-entered-in-a-joint-venture-company-agreement-with-the|url-status=dead}}</ref> Payra Port is the 3rd sea port of Bangladesh located in general area in between latitude 21<sup>o</sup>15’- 22<sup>o</sup>00’ North and longitude 90<sup>o</sup>00’- 90<sup>o</sup>30’.
